title: A study on the network pharmacology of HQGZWWT that prevents CINP by inhibiting ferroptosis through regulation of the p38/c-FOS/NF-kB pathway.
authors: Li, Mingzhu; Zhang, Wenshun; Jin, Shengbo; Jiang, Yuxin; Yao, Huini; Yu, Jun; Zhang, Mingxue; Li, Pengfei; Piao, Haozhe
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过p38/c-FOS/NF-kB通路抑制铁死亡防治化疗神经痛，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain (CINP) is a frequent side effect of chemotherapy, and the mechanisms by which Huangqi Guizhi Wuwu Tang (HQGZWWT) prevents and treats CINP remain to be further elucidated. BACKGROUND: Oxaliplatin is a widely used chemotherapy drug with proven efficacy against multiple malignancies; however, its significant side effects severely limit patient dosing. One such effect is CINP, which involves multiple factors. Ferroptosis, a form of cell death, plays a crucial role in maintaining chronic neuropathic pain. HQGZWWT effectively prevents and treats CINP and is recommended by the Expert Consensus on Diagnosis and Treatment of Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathic Pain (A + Level). However, the specific mechanism remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: In this study, the preventive and therapeutic effects of HQGZWWT and its major monomeric component paeoniflorin on CINP were investigated, and the effects of HQGZWWT on CINP through the regulation of ferroptosis mediated by the p38/c-FOS/NF-kappaB pathway were explored. METHODS: In this study, a CINP rat model was established to evaluate the protective efficacy of astragalus-cinnamon five-ingredient decoction against neural injury in CINP rats. Further investigations focused on the pharmacological effects of its primary monomer, paeoniflorin. Through in vitro experiments using rat dorsal root ganglion (DRG) cells (CPR126) and in vivo experiments with SD rats, the potential mechanism through which paeoniflorin modulates ferroptosis by regulating the p38/c-FOS/NF-kappaB pathway was investigated. The corresponding targets were screened via network pharmacology and validated through molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and immunofluorescence colocalization. RESULTS: HQGZWWT effectively alleviated oxaliplatin-induced neuropathic pain. In vivo experiments demonstrated that HQGZWWT improved mechanical pain sensitization and lowered thermal pain thresholds in oxaliplatin-treated rats. Hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining revealed that HQGZWWT mitigated oxaliplatin-induced abnormalities in dorsal root ganglion neurons, including indistinct nuclei, reduced proliferative activity, and abnormal neuronal axons, as well as a disorganized sciatic nerve arrangement and increased intercellular spacing. Transmission electron microscopy revealed uniform mitochondrial structure and density in the HQGZWWT high-concentration group, counteracting oxaliplatin-induced reductions in mitochondrial density, vacuolation and rupture of mitochondrial membranes, and structural blurring. The HQGZWWT-high group exhibited reduced oxaliplatin-induced increases in Malondialdehyde(MDA)levels. The total tissue iron and Fe(2+) levels indicated that HQGZWWT mitigated oxaliplatin-induced iron accumulation. Through network pharmacology screening, bioactive component analysis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations, in vitro experiments identified paeoniflorin as the optimal active monomer in HQGZWWT. CCK-8 assays confirmed 50 muM as the optimal paeoniflorin concentration and demonstrated that oxaliplatin induces DRG cell death via ferroptosis. Paeoniflorin effectively protected rat DRG cells against oxaliplatin-induced damage and reduced oxaliplatin-induced reactive oxygen species (ROS) production. Mitochondrial electron microscopy revealed that 50 muM paeoniflorin improved oxaliplatin-induced alterations in DRG cells, including reduced mitochondrial density, mitochondrial vacuolation, and cristae damage, while decreasing oxidative stress levels. These findings provide strong evidence for the inhibitory effect of 50 muM paeoniflorin on ferroptosis. Additionally, network pharmacology identified the p38/c-Fos/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, validating the hypothesis that HQGZWWT and paeoniflorin inhibit ferroptosis via this pathway to prevent CINP. CONCLUSION: HQGZWWT significantly ameliorated CINP by increasing sciatic nerve conduction velocity, reducing oxidative stress and inflammatory responses, and inhibiting ferroptosis. Both HQGZWWT and its active monomeric component paeoniflorin protect neurons by suppressing ferroptosis, thereby exerting preventive and therapeutic effects against CINP. These findings provide new insights into the clinical treatment of CINP with HQGZWWT. Inhibiting ferroptosis by regulating the p38/c-FOS/NF-kappaB pathway through HQGZWWT and its primary monomeric component paeoniflorin represents a promising therapeutic strategy for preventing and treating oxaliplatin-induced CINP.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：化疗诱导的神经病理性疼痛（CINP）是化疗的常见副作用，而黄芪桂枝五物汤（HQGZWWT）预防和治疗CINP的机制仍有待进一步阐明。背景：奥沙利铂是一种广泛使用的化疗药物，已被证明对多种恶性肿瘤有效；然而，其显著副作用严重限制了患者的用药剂量。其中一种副作用是CINP，涉及多种因素。铁死亡（ferroptosis）作为一种细胞死亡形式，在维持慢性神经病理性疼痛中发挥关键作用。HQGZWWT能有效预防和治疗CINP，并被《化疗诱导的周围神经病理性疼痛诊治专家共识》（A+级）推荐。然而，其具体机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究探讨了HQGZWWT及其主要单体成分芍药苷（paeoniflorin）对CINP的预防和治疗作用，并探索了HQGZWWT通过调控p38/c-FOS/NF-kappaB通路介导的铁死亡对CINP的影响。方法：本研究建立CINP大鼠模型，评估黄芪桂枝五物汤对CINP大鼠神经损伤的保护效果。进一步研究聚焦于其主要单体芍药苷的药理作用。通过使用大鼠背根神经节（DRG）细胞（CPR126）的体外实验和SD大鼠的体内实验，研究了芍药苷通过调控p38/c-FOS/NF-kappaB通路调节铁死亡的潜在机制。通过网络药理学筛选相应靶点，并通过分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和免疫荧光共定位进行验证。结果：HQGZWWT有效缓解了奥沙利铂诱导的神经病理性疼痛。体内实验表明，HQGZWWT改善了奥沙利铂处理大鼠的机械痛敏化并降低了热痛阈值。苏木精-伊红（HE）染色显示，HQGZWWT减轻了奥沙利铂诱导的背根神经节神经元异常，包括细胞核模糊、增殖活性降低和神经元轴突异常，以及坐骨神经排列紊乱和细胞间隙增大。透射电子显微镜显示，HQGZWWT高浓度组线粒体结构和密度均匀，抵消了奥沙利铂诱导的线粒体密度降低、线粒体膜空泡化和破裂以及结构模糊。HQGZWWT高浓度组降低了奥沙利铂诱导的丙二醛（MDA）水平升高。组织总铁和Fe(2+)水平表明，HQGZWWT减轻了奥沙利铂诱导的铁积累。通过网络药理学筛选、生物活性成分分析、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，体外实验确定芍药苷为HQGZWWT中的最优活性单体。CCK-8实验确认50 μM为芍药苷的最佳浓度，并证明奥沙利铂通过铁死亡诱导DRG细胞死亡。芍药苷有效保护大鼠DRG细胞免受奥沙利铂诱导的损伤，并减少了奥沙利铂诱导的活性氧（ROS）产生。线粒体电子显微镜显示，50 μM芍药苷改善了奥沙利铂诱导的DRG细胞改变，包括线粒体密度降低、线粒体空泡化和嵴损伤，同时降低了氧化应激水平。这些发现为50 μM芍药苷对铁死亡的抑制作用提供了有力证据。此外，网络药理学鉴定了p38/c-Fos/NF-kappaB信号通路，验证了HQGZWWT和芍药苷通过该通路抑制铁死亡以预防CINP的假设。结论：HQGZWWT通过增加坐骨神经传导速度、减少氧化应激和炎症反应以及抑制铁死亡，显著改善了CINP。HQGZWWT及其活性单体成分芍药苷均通过抑制铁死亡保护神经元，从而对CINP发挥预防和治疗作用。这些发现为HQGZWWT临床治疗CINP提供了新见解。通过HQGZWWT及其主要单体成分芍药苷调控p38/c-FOS/NF-kappaB通路抑制铁死亡，是预防和治疗奥沙利铂诱导的CINP的一种有前景的治疗策略。
